text: Before the world, there was only water, dark and endless.
From it rose a lotus. And in the lotus, Brahma, the creator, opened his eyes.
With every breath, he painted the world into being: mountains, rivers, every living thing.
But what is made must be kept. Vishnu, the preserver, holds it in balance,
returning, age after age, whenever the world loses its way.
And when an age is complete, Shiva dances.
His dance clears the old away, so that something new can begin.
Three faces of one turning cosmos.
Creation. Preservation. Dissolution. And then, again, the water.
